finding: A pending delivery aged between four and five minutes was ineligible for rediscovery while its run was still within the orphan grace period.
change: Align the bounded pending-delivery selection with the existing five-minute orphan grace period. Existing source, state, native identity and atomic reservation checks remain in force.

evidence.scope: Synthetic query fixture, not real database recovery

evidence.limitation: POSIX orphan sweep skipped on Windows. Process-tree cancellation and deadline tests ran locally. Lease fixtures use an in-memory store.

remaining: Prove restart and durable recovery with actual processes and an isolated database.

Verify source checkpoint persistence, workspace restoration, cancellation races and cross-tenant isolation for the actual shared engineering paths.
Complete remaining Phase 1 criteria and exact-source CI before claiming acceptance.
